source: interface.json revision4 and root-approved additive trusted-config argv; original X argument envelope retained
transport_principal: Fixed by trusted runner before adapter startup. JSON peer arguments with transport_principal/trusted_config/profile_registry/slot_registry/checker must reject; config is only read by host-side adapter then supplied to X constructor.
profiles: Array {id,path,sha256}; actual immutable profile file bytes, exact selected dependency manifest plus generated tsconfig closure checked. No peer profile installation.
slots: Array of interface.slot.trusted_registration_required entries. Same state_root and immutable plan are shared across independent adapter owners. Registry changes after first use conflict and cannot create duplicate credits.
grants: Array {ref,record}; ref has owner,id,record_path,sha256. Real record contains principal,operations and original_request complete bytes plus request_digest,namespace/session/generation,original source refs,slot_ref,role. X resolves actual record before each operation. Having a caller string is never a grant.

references.snapshots: Array {ref,registered_scope}. registered_scope fixed by trusted fixture from original accepted session/execution record and not read from supplied ref. Complete actual archive/manifest/record required.
references.F_views: Array {version_ref,materialized_root,manifest_ref,domain,resource_id}; actual verified F original plus materialization.
references.owner_receipts: Array {ref,registered_scope}; complete actual S owner receipt payload + file ref; owner scope is original X accepted execution, not supplied receipt context.

read_only_roots: Array of exact role/source/target/manifest_ref/content_ref objects. Targets fixed /opt,/harness,/input,/workspace. Dependency generated tsconfig is explicitly added to member manifest, original882 licensed files remain unchanged.
allowed_harness_entries: Array {path,sha256,argv_modes}; exact ordinary file bytes. X does not parse Pi, test harness mode semantics or source code.
lifetime: Configuration freezes trusted authority root/resolver identity/namespace/principal/profile/slot/grant rules, not all future facts. Unknown Engine IDs are registered as owner facts only after actual execution by trusted owner. Grants and original registrations never silently rebind; dynamic owner/restore facts append immutable refs and fsync. Peer cannot register, replace root or mutate rules.
not_authority: This validation fixture is not a production S implementation. Actual X product must perform authority matching and durable calls/slot retention itself. Independent oracle compares raw files and actual Engine, not fixture accepted=true.

dynamic_reference_authorities.root: fixed trusted ordinary control root, never mounted into task
dynamic_reference_authorities.identity: fixed resolver identity/principal/namespace and rule hashes, not supplied by peer
dynamic_reference_authorities.registration: trusted S/F owner writes complete immutable files and append-only registration with real fsync; registry ID never rebinds bytes or scope. Future records may be registered without replacing constructor configuration.
dynamic_reference_authorities.expectation: X obtains expected original execution/session tuple from its own previously accepted original request. Registered owner record alone cannot supply expected scope. Full registered ref/current actual bytes are compared; latest-path indirection forbidden.
